layers.name: Runtime Application and API
layers.description: Composes the on-device Python runtime and exposes its HTTP, event, agent, provider, MCP, and tool execution boundaries.

layers.description: Implements ReSono domain behavior, external connectors, memory, creations, imports, skills, plugins, and standards-based extension lifecycles.

layers.name: Data and Security Foundation
layers.description: Owns SQLite migrations and repositories, runtime configuration, credential protection, pairing, outbound policy, logging, and supervised execution foundations.

layers.name: Android Product Experience
layers.description: Implements the native HOME composition, Browser Voice-derived design system, hardware input routing, and working Voice, Cards, Calendar, Tasks, Settings, and Camera surfaces.

layers.name: Android Platform Integration
layers.description: Bridges the native product to the local runtime, HTTPS management service, Android lifecycle, display power, motor hardware, and system-service contracts.

layers.name: Web Management Experience
layers.description: Implements the browser management application, shared design tokens, responsive styling, assets, and client-side runtime interactions.

layers.name: Contracts and Configuration
layers.description: Defines build manifests, package metadata, Android resources, plugin manifests, and machine-readable schemas that configure implementation boundaries.

layers.name: Build and Release Infrastructure
layers.description: Contains Android and system-image build scripts, image overlays, inventories, candidate assembly inputs, and release verification tooling.

layers.name: Verification
layers.description: Exercises runtime contracts, Android behavior, architecture boundaries, packaging, and integration behavior across the product implementation.
